evidence: Touches the coins and chainstate database compaction behavior and carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.
rationale: Adds default logging and a low-disk-space warning prior to automatic chainstate compaction to alert operators of potential disk exhaustion. As reported in issue #36585, background compaction could silently fill the disk and cause the node to hang, making visibility and warnings worthwhile even though compaction itself is not prevented.
